narr: Scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms developing on the afternoon of May 21st in a moderate to strongly unstable environment with MLCAPE values in excess of 2000 J/kg but relatively weak shear. Atmospheric moisture was high with precipitable water values greater than 1.5 inches. Storms that developed were slow moving and trained over the same area around Columbia causing significant flooding in downtown including the Five Points area and at the intersection of Main and Whaley St.
ev: Multiple reports of flash flooding throughout downtown Columbia. Considerable street flooding in Five Points with flood waters encroaching on businesses. Westbound lanes blocked near the 2000 block of Gervais St near the railroad overpass. A vehicle was flooded at Read St and Harden St.
Richland ESD reported roadway flooding on Olympia Ave at Heyward St. Social media reports showed photos of police blocking the road due to water covering the road on Pendleton St at Huger St.
